why: `retrieve` took a `class` argument and never read it. Filtering on a class the ontology does not declare produced zero results and reported nothing wrong, which tells a caller its typo was a true negative — the exact failure `query`'s `unknown-class` rejection exists to prevent, one tool over, on the tool an agent reaches for first. The filter is validated BEFORE the search, so `results` is empty because nothing ran and `absence` is null: a rejection is not an absence and a server carrying both would be answering two questions with one key.
